stock.description: Maiyue Technology Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the development of application software. It operates through the following segments: Integrated Information Technology (IT) Solutions Services; Sales of Hardware and Software, and Standalone IT Services. The Integrated Information Technology Solutions Services segment include design of integrated IT solutions accommodating the specific requirements of customers and development of solution-based application systems. The Sales of Hardware and Software segment refers to the provision of essential equipment support for the construction of education IT solutions. The Standalone IT Services segment involve the provision of maintenance and support services on customers' IT system based on customers' need. The Company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Nanning, China.
